name: ModelVariant433_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant433_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, gets the slot part, uploads the texture images and sets up the effect records, otherwise it runs one frame (from the config trigger frame: lines, quad groups, rings before phase 2 and ribbons from phase 1, then tint and fade) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md); notes/overlays/north-american-model-variant450.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant450.md
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the European and French images build it through french_model_variant/variant450_entry.c with the PAL palette x; the German, Italian and Spanish entries are still assembly. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

name: gModelVariant433_aImages
